Container.Name: snappy-chat
Container.Overview: A lightweight chat interface for Ollama running on your local network.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Port used to access Snappy Chat.

Config.Name: Ollama Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Ollama on your Mac, for example http://192.168.1.25:11434. Set a DHCP reservation for the Mac so this address stays stable.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Container Name / Host
Config.Description: Container name or network-reachable host for PostgreSQL. Put both containers on the same custom Docker network to use the PostgreSQL container name.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port reachable from this container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Name of the existing PostgreSQL database for Snappy Chat. The database user needs permission to create tables and indexes.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Username
Config.Description: PostgreSQL user that Snappy Chat will use to connect.

Config.Name: Initial Admin Username
Config.Description: Username for the initial administrator. This is used to create the admin account on first startup; changing it does not rename an existing account.

Config.Name: Initial Admin Password
Config.Description: Initial administrator password (at least 12 characters). Only used when creating the admin account for the first time.

Config.Name: Secure Session Cookie
Config.Description: Set to true when Snappy Chat is served over HTTPS; leave false for direct HTTP access on a trusted LAN.
